name: Horry
gaps: Source query returned 14961 rows; 12037 stayed in the 5.0–150.0 acre band after the parcel-id and geometry checks.

Parcels are Parcels (HorryCountyGIS_GS) (https://www.horrycounty.org/gispublic/rest/services/Public/HorryCountyGIS_GS/MapServer/24). Acreage is 5.0–150.0 inclusive. No Opportunity Zone status, school grade, or base flood elevation is stored.
qPublic and Beacon property-appraiser links are stored as patterns and were not requested.
Owner phone and email are not ingested. SCDOT AADT stays the query-time statewide join.
No situs street/city fields on public parcel layer (Owner* mailing only); join addresses from Addresses layer (GS/22) spatially if needed.
City of Myrtle Beach has its own zoning REST — use companion 45051-myrtle-beach.yaml inside city limits.
Assessor/Land Records online access requires free Horry County account as of 2026-03-16 notice; GIS REST remains public.
Sale history is last-sale fields only (SaleDate / DeedBook / DeedPage), not multi-sale table.
